name: Forge and Form Summer Studio (Mines Labriola Innovation Hub)
org: Colorado School of Mines, Labriola Innovation Hub
what_you_do: Spend one week on the Mines campus in Golden building and designing with materials science and engineering. 30 students per session. Lunch included.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors who are at least 16 during camp.
pay_detail: $850, lunch included. Bring a laptop if you can; loaners are available.
duration: One week, 9 AM to 4 PM. 2026 sessions: July 13 to 17 and July 20 to 24.
deadline_text: The 2026 applications closed March 1 at 11:59 PM MST. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online; the 2026 page lists a waitlist form. Questions: innohub@mines.edu.
notes: The page blocked our reader, so it was read through a page summary tool. Confirm the cost and dates on the Mines page.
